RUNE KINGUNSTOPPABLE GODvs. EVIL MADNESS

Story, heroes and monsters drawn by Leo.

Dead dropped a Madness Bomb and turned every good guy evil. Everyone except the Rune King, because his good spirit can never change. Beat the cursed bad guys to set them free and they fight on your side. Split them into an army, travel through strange new lands, and stop Evil Madness.

Pick your math to start

How to play
  • Drag the round stick to walk. The world keeps going, so walk as far as you want!
  • SWORD (or tap the screen) slashes the bad guys close to you. LASER shoots a laser out of every claw at once.
  • Bad guys are good guys under a curse. When you beat one, the curse breaks, they turn back to their real colours, and they help you.
  • SPLIT makes every helper split in two. Watch out: Evil Madness's scribble balls can curse your helpers again!
  • Freeing good guys fills the GOD meter. When it's full, the Rune King gets giant and unstoppable for a little while.
  • MATH: get it right and your answer becomes your sword power for 3 slashes.
  • Your friend Gemwing flies with you and shoots gems.
  • At the end of each land is a Madness Gate. Beat Evil Madness there to open it and go somewhere new.

Keyboard: ← → ↑ ↓ walk · Space sword · L laser · X split · G god · M math · P pause
